name: True Shuffle
author: moshi
description: Native shuffle modes in the player and queue. Keeps your existing shuffle settings and cycle history.

settings.label: Shuffle shortcut
settings.description: Follow Noctis opens these modes with its Shuffle key (Ctrl+S by default), including keys changed in Settings. Enter another modified key, or off for native keyboard shuffle. No music or queue changes until you choose a mode.

settings.label: Show shuffle modes
settings.description: Open the native player shuffle menu. Choosing a mode starts it.

settings.label: Default mode
settings.description: The mode the shuffle menu offers first while shuffle is off.

settings.label: For you: new songs
settings.description: How many songs you have not heard yet the For you mode mixes in: about one in ten, one in five, or one in three.

settings.label: Default source
settings.description: Which songs a mode shuffles when you pick it without choosing a source: the current queue, the playlist that is open, or your whole library.

settings.label: Exclude disliked songs by default
settings.description: Off: disliked songs have the same chance as other eligible songs. On: exclude them from all modes.
